title: A Retreat for Women

body:
My wife, Grace, worked beside me in pastoral ministry for 24 years. In addition to being an amazing mother to 4 amazing kids (who now have produced 5 equally amazing grandkids), Grace became a corporate consultant and trainer, specializing in Myers-Briggs, team-building, communication, and conflict resolution. She branched out to help individuals, couples, and families improve their lives and relationships using the tools she employed in the professional world.

 Last year, she and some friends teamed up to start Insight Retreats.

 The big idea: invite groups of women to gather to learn, explore, and grow together.

 The next Insight Retreat will be April 26-29, 2018 , here in Southwest Florida (Marco Island). If you would like to give a meaningful gift to a woman you love … or if you are a woman who needs a few days in the company of caring peers who are trying to make sense of their life’s story and are curious about their own inner journey, I hope you’ll  check out Insight Retreats.
